pages.title: Climb Everest
pages.creator: A Sole Proprietorship
pages.description: Lead an expedition from Base Camp to the summit in Climb Everest. Cross crevasses on ladders, clip into fixed ropes, and climb the Lhotse Face while managing oxygen, water, warmth, and stamina. Rest and restock at camps, watch for weather changes, and use checkpoints to resume your ascent later.

pages.title: Speedy Runner
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Run through the streets in Speedy Runner and dodge obstacles as they come into view. Collect coins and activate boosts when you see a chance to keep the run going. Unlock new skins along the way and see how far you can make it on your next attempt.

pages.title: Color Wood Animal Jam
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Slide wooden animal pieces into their matching spots in Color Wood Animal Jam. Look at which pieces are blocking the way and decide what to move first. A piece can get in the way of another, so plan the order before you slide everything into place.

pages.title: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together a holiday outfit in Fashionista Christmas Eve Party. Look through the festive clothes and choose accessories that go with the pieces you’ve picked. Try different combinations to decide how you want the fashionista to look when it’s time for the Christmas Eve celebration.

pages.title: Car Collision Master
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Drive a blue jeep into clashes with rivals in Car Collision Master. Follow the looping route through the desert canyon and watch where the other vehicles are heading. Customize your jeep, take on friends, and see how your results compare on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Stickman Escape School
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Choose a tool from the box in Stickman Escape School and see whether it helps the student get out. The teacher has left the classroom, giving him a chance to make his move. Pick carefully, because the wrong item can get him caught.

pages.title: Last to leave circle Obby
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Stay inside a shrinking boundary in Last to leave circle Obby. Dodge traps and handle obstacle-course challenges while competing against other players. Every move has to keep you in the circle, so watch the edge as the space gets tighter and try to outlast the group.

pages.title: Capybara Block Drop
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Drop numbered pieces into columns in Capybara Block Drop and merge matching values. Look for combinations that clear room for the next pieces, because the game ends when the board fills. Choose a column with the next move in mind to keep the capybara’s run going.

pages.title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Reassemble flags in Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags. Tap the banner pieces that belong together and watch them slide into position as you make a match. Work through the pieces on the board and finish each flag to clear the puzzle.

pages.title: Solitaire Klondike
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Build descending stacks of alternating colors in Solitaire Klondike. Move cards to uncover ones you need and build the foundations by suit from ace upward. If you want to start over, deal a fresh layout and try a different sequence of moves.

pages.title: Skinfluencer Beauty Routine
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Follow Emma through a beauty routine in Skinfluencer Beauty Routine. Try out the makeover and fashion options, then choose the details you want for her look. Each step gives you a chance to experiment before you put the finished style together.

pages.title: Board Kings Board Dice
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Roll dice to move around the board in Board Kings Board Dice. Spend the points you earn on buildings and upgrades to grow your empire. Visit other players’ boards and attack their buildings while deciding where to invest on your own board.

pages.title: Spider Rope Hero City Fight
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Swing through the city in Spider Rope Hero City Fight. Use the hero’s rope and climbing abilities to chase down gangsters and take on the mafia. The president has been kidnapped, so follow the chase and fight through the criminals to bring him back safely.

pages.title: Animation & Coloring Alphabet Lore
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Explore 16 letters in Animation & Coloring Alphabet Lore and give them your own colors. Try different drawing tools to fill the designs, or switch to Free Draw and make something from scratch. There’s no timer or score, so you can keep working on a picture as long as you like.

pages.title: Boing Bang Adventure Lite
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Take on a bouncing alien in Boing Bang Adventure Lite. Use your blast gun and pick up power-ups when they appear, while watching where the enemy will land next. Play alone or team up with someone in local co-op to handle the bouncing threat together.

pages.title: Vacation Summer Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Choose vacation outfits for six friends in Vacation Summer Dress Up. Browse 225 items, including dresses, hats, handbags, and shoes, and decide what suits each girl’s summer plans. Put together a look for one friend, then try different combinations for the rest of the group.

pages.title: Pro Cycling 3D Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Race a bicycle along country roads in Pro Cycling 3D Simulator. Work through five tournament missions and keep the rider on course as you go for the win. Lift the handlebars when you want to try earning extra coins during a ride.

pages.title: Text Talk
pages.creator: Double Coconut
pages.description: Build words from a handful of letters in Text Talk. Fill the crossword grid and keep looking for bonus words that don’t have a place in the puzzle. There are more than 200 levels, starting with straightforward letter sets and moving into tougher combinations.

pages.title: Let's Color Noob
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Color blocky characters in Let's Color Noob with the drawing tools and stickers. Spin the lucky wheel for points to help unlock more pictures, or switch to drawing mode when you want a blank canvas. The game saves your progress so you can return to a picture later.

pages.title: Parking Mania
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description: Get a car out of a crowded lot in Parking Mania. Look at which vehicles or obstacles block the route, then work out the order of moves that opens a way to the exit. Each level gives you a different parking layout to untangle.

pages.title: Ice Breaker
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: Command a pirate ship and battle rival crews in Ice Breaker. Use your cannons to sink enemy ships and collect the riches they leave behind. Spend your haul on ship strength, faster shots, or upgrades that make defeated ships drop more loot.

pages.title: Balls Sorting Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Sort balls by color into groups of four in Balls Sorting Deluxe. Easy mode gives you fewer balls and more tanks to work with, while Hard mode leaves you less room to rearrange them. Use an extra tank reward if you need more space to complete a group.

pages.title: Halloween Snake and Blocks
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Drag to steer through Halloween Snake and Blocks. Collect points to grow longer and give blocks with high numbers a wide berth. Pick up stars to unlock new snake skins, then see how far you can get and where your score lands on the global leaderboard.

pages.title: Halloween Lines Saga
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Line up five or more identical Halloween items in Halloween Lines Saga. Rows, columns, and diagonals all count, so look for a clear route before the board fills up. Use the undo, sword, or potion when you need help, and visit the lucky wheel for bonus items.

pages.title: Idle Pet Business
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Earn coins by looking after animals in Idle Pet Business. Use the money to unlock new pets or upgrade the ones you already have so they bring in more income. The shop keeps earning while you’re away, so you can come back and put the proceeds toward another expansion.

pages.title: Twirl
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Fit figures onto the board in Twirl. Drag a piece where you want it and rotate it when the puzzle gives you that option. Look at how its edges fit with the spaces around it before you settle on a position, then try the next arrangement.

pages.title: Friday Night Funkin First Date
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress the couple for a night out in Friday Night Funkin First Date. Browse their wardrobes for party outfits and choose a hairstyle for each of them. Try different combinations to give both characters a look that suits their first date.

pages.title: Yoyo Hero 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tap an enemy to strike with a yo-yo in Yoyo Hero 3D. Take down every opponent in the current area to reach the next level. Collect the rewards from each clear and use them to unlock stronger yo-yos for later fights.

pages.title: 2 For 2048
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Connect dots with the same number in 2 For 2048. Follow horizontal and vertical paths to build a group and turn the matching values into a higher one. Look over the board after each merge and use the new number to set up your next connection.

pages.title: Super Villainy
pages.creator: Bad Viking Ltd
pages.description: Fight rival villains in Super Villainy. Fire at enemies and build up your firepower with upgrades as you battle for the top spot. Add turrets or recruit minions to help you take on the opposition when the fight gets crowded.

pages.title: Fire Trucks Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find seven changes between each pair of pictures in Fire Trucks Differences. Tap the spot where the images differ, then move on to the next detail before time runs out. There are ten levels, each with another fire truck scene to compare.

pages.title: Santa Wheelie Bike Challenge
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Keep Santa’s front wheel off the road in Santa Wheelie Bike Challenge. Find a balance that lets the bike travel on one wheel without tipping over or dropping the front tire. Hold the wheelie as far down the road as you can.

pages.title: BFF Clover Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Emma, Mia, and Clara choose weekend outfits in BFF Clover Fashion. Browse the clothes for each princess and try combinations inspired by their new style ideas. Put together a separate look for each friend before the weekend begins.

pages.title: Pumpking adventure
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Help a pumpkin find its way home in Pumpking adventure. Guide it through levels with obstacles and enemies, and collect bonuses as you go. Work your way past each opponent and keep moving to see what’s waiting on the next stretch of the route.

pages.title: Impostor Royal Solo Kill
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Fight to be the last impostor aboard a shuttle in Impostor Royal Solo Kill. Watch for supplies that drop by parachute and grab a weapon such as a sword, gun, or chainsaw. Spend points earned in matches on new impostor looks and hats.

pages.title: Colored Water & Pin
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pull pins to direct colored water into matching flasks in Colored Water & Pin. Check how the liquid will flow before removing a pin, then choose the order that fills the right containers. Finish each of the 30 puzzles to unlock the next one.

pages.title: Falling Babble
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Watch the white ball and time its contact with enemies in Falling Babble. Click or tap as it lines up with a target to destroy it. Keep following the ball after each hit so you’re ready to act when it reaches the next enemy.

pages.title: Falling Gifts
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slide a shopping cart under falling presents in Falling Gifts. Check the wish list and catch the gifts it asks for while letting the other items fall past. You have 60 seconds to score, so watch what’s coming down before moving to the next present.

pages.title: Pull The Rocket
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Get all the balls into the bucket in Pull The Rocket. Release them in an order that lets colored balls dye the white ones before they land. Look at where the bombs are before you make a move, and use the fireworks when you need to change a ball’s color.

pages.title: Stickman Fights
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take control of a street fighter in Stickman Fights. Move into range and attack the other stickmen as you work your way through the battles. Look for openings when your opponent comes close and see how far you can take your fighter against the competition.

pages.title: Snowman Couples
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Put together six pictures of snowman couples in Snowman Couples. Choose a puzzle mode, then drag the pieces together using details such as the snowmen’s outlines and the colors around them. Finish one scene and choose a different picture when you’re ready for another layout.

pages.title: Pretty Box Bakery Game
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Bake a cake shaped like a makeup kit in Pretty Box Bakery Game. Work through the bakery steps, then pick candies to decorate the finished cake. Arrange the sweets to give the cosmetic-box design the colors and details you want.

pages.title: Sprinter Heroes
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Alternate keys to sprint in Sprinter Heroes. Use Left and Right for one runner or A and D for the other, and keep a steady rhythm to build speed. Race across seven continents on your own or against a friend, with tougher races as the tournament progresses.

pages.title: Coin Run
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Roll a coin along winding tracks in Coin Run and guide it into the hole. Watch for spikes, spinning gates, and other obstacles before you reach them. Speed ramps can make the coin harder to steer, so get it lined up as you approach the end of each level.

pages.title: Triple Jack
pages.creator: Zigiz
pages.description: Play cards across three stacks in Triple Jack and aim to bring each total to 21. Every 21 fills part of the combo meter. Going over the target counts as a bust, and three busts end the game, so check all three totals before placing a card.

pages.title: Monster Trucks Coloring Pages
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Color eight different truck pictures in Monster Trucks Coloring Pages. Pick shades for the bodywork, wheels, and other details, then move on to another design when you’re done. Save a finished picture if you want to keep it or print it later.

pages.title: Tractor Mania
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Haul goods from the warehouse to the factory in Tractor Mania. Drive carefully so more of the load makes it to the destination and earns you coins. Spend your pay in the garage on tractors, trailers, or upgrades that help with the next delivery.

pages.title: Drifting Mustang Car Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six pictures of a Mustang in motion in Drifting Mustang Car Puzzle. Choose 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces for any image. Look for the car’s body lines and the details behind it to work out which pieces belong side by side.

pages.title: BodyBuilder Ring Fighting Club Wrestling Games
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Fight other bodybuilders in the ring in BodyBuilder Ring Fighting Club Wrestling Games. Face opponents in 3D bouts and look for openings to strike as they come into range. Work through the matches and take on more gym fighters as you go.

pages.title: Smoothie Maker
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Make colorful drinks in Smoothie Maker. Choose ingredients for a smoothie and decide how you want the finished drink to look. Add decorations before serving it, then try another combination when you’re ready to make a different drink.

pages.title: Ford Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Piece together pictures of Ford cars in Ford Cars Jigsaw. Drag the pieces into place and use the shapes of the vehicles or the background to find joins. Pick from three puzzle modes and take as much time as you need to finish each image.

pages.title: Chaki Memory Game
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Study the pictures in Chaki Memory Game and remember what you’ve seen. Click to identify the images as you work through each memory challenge. Pay attention to where the pictures appear and use what you remember to get through the levels.

pages.title: Grand Police Car Chase Drive Racing 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Drive a police car through city traffic in Grand Police Car Chase Drive Racing 2020. Follow the streets as you take on police driving and pursuit challenges. Keep control of the car around other vehicles while you work your way through the city.

pages.title: US Army Commando Shooting Warzone 2020
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Take on armed rivals in US Army Commando Shooting Warzone 2020. Look for a clear line of fire and aim before shooting as you work through the combat area. Keep track of nearby opponents and try to survive their attacks during the mission.

pages.title: Body Builder Ring Fighting Arena : Wrestling Games
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Step into the ring in Body Builder Ring Fighting Arena : Wrestling Games. Face other fighters in bouts inspired by boxing, wrestling, and martial arts. Watch where your opponent moves and choose when to attack as you fight your way through the arena.

pages.title: Pixel Battlegrounds.IO
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Land on an island and look for equipment in Pixel Battlegrounds.IO. Choose a character before the match, then search the area for what you need to fight. Pick when to engage opponents and try to stay alive as the battle continues.

pages.title: Grand Slap Master Kings Slap Competition 2020
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Face opponents in a slapping contest in Grand Slap Master Kings Slap Competition 2020. Take your turn when it comes and try to land a stronger slap before your rival answers. Work through the match and see how long you can keep winning exchanges.

pages.title: Moto Pizza
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Ride a delivery bike to customers in Moto Pizza. Get to the highlighted parking spot before you’re late, then leave the bike and walk the order to the customer’s door. Finish the handoff before setting out on the next delivery.

pages.title: Foot Hospital
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Treat patients with sore feet in Foot Hospital. Choose tools for each problem and work through the treatment steps. Once you’ve taken care of the injury, finish up by treating the nails before you move on to the next patient.

pages.title: Choly Water Hop
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Hop across a lake on floating platforms in Choly Water Hop. Use a normal jump for a close landing or a double jump to reach farther. A fall into the water ends the attempt, so judge each gap as you try to travel farther and raise your score.

pages.title: City Bus Offroad Driving Sim
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Drive a passenger bus through city streets and along highways in City Bus Offroad Driving Sim. Watch the route as it changes and leave space to steer the bus through traffic. Keep control of the vehicle as you carry passengers along the course.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Fishing Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Go fishing with Baby Hazel and Uncle John in Baby Hazel Fishing Time. Help Hazel pack the supplies she needs before they leave, then join them at the fishing spot. Pay attention to what each of them asks for as the trip goes on.

pages.title: Land Rover Defender 90 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six pictures of a Land Rover Defender 90 in Land Rover Defender 90 Puzzle. Pick a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the vehicle’s square panels and the edges of the background to decide where the pieces fit.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Home Recovery
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help Dotted Girl recover at home in Dotted Girl Home Recovery. Start by positioning her injured hand and leg, then change her into something comfortable. Make her a smoothie and put on her favorite music to help her settle in after leaving the hospital.

pages.title: Neon Blaster
pages.creator: GAMEE
pages.description: Defend your base from incoming blocks in Neon Blaster. Keep firing as the blocks approach and spend upgrades on your weapon so you can deal with more of them. Watch which targets are closest and clear them before they reach your position.

pages.title: ATM Cash Deposit
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drive around town to refill cash machines in ATM Cash Deposit. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move on foot or behind the wheel as you travel between stops. Find the ATMs across the city and complete a deposit at each one.

pages.title: Banana Copter Swing
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Climb past moving obstacles in Banana Copter Swing. Each tap reverses your direction, so watch how the next obstacle moves and turn when there’s space to pass. Time a series of quick changes when the route narrows and see how high you can go.

pages.title: Baby Bake Cake
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Make and decorate a cake in Baby Bake Cake. Gather the ingredients, add fruit, and use the mixer to prepare the batter. Choose a tray shape and color, bake the cake in the oven, then put the decorations on the finished cake.

pages.title: Super Doll Makeup Transform
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Give a superhero a new look in Super Doll Makeup Transform. Start with a spa session, then try lipstick, eyeshadow, and face paint in different colors. Save the finished design when you find a combination you want to keep.

pages.title: Wavy Trip
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fly a spaceship through an obstacle course in Wavy Trip. Hold to rise and release to drop, making small changes in height to stay in the clear. Pick up coins for the spaceship garage as you try to get farther without a crash.

pages.title: Origin Fashion Fair
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Shop for outfits and dress the characters in Origin Fashion Fair. Try dresses with different hairstyles, shoes, and jewelry, then switch to another character to put together a new look. Use the items you’ve picked to finish the group’s outfits for the fair.

pages.title: Rusty Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild six pictures of rusty cars in Rusty Cars Puzzle. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece version of each image. Follow the shapes of the body panels and the patches of rust to see where neighboring pieces join.

pages.title: Love Poly 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Rotate scattered polygons in Love Poly 3D until they form a complete picture. Swipe to view the pieces from another angle and look for outlines that start to connect. Keep adjusting the rotation until the fragments line up and the hidden image becomes clear.

pages.title: Karting
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Click to turn the kart in Karting. Watch for the next corner and wait until the kart is in position before you steer. Keep timing the turns to avoid crashing and see how long you can stay on the track.

pages.title: Mmm Fingers
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Hold your finger on the screen and keep it away from monsters in Mmm Fingers. Move around their teeth while keeping contact with the play area. Lifting your finger or touching a monster ends the run, so look ahead for a clear path.

pages.title: DEF Island!
pages.creator: 4j.com
pages.description: Use a cannon to protect your island in DEF Island! Aim at approaching boats and aircraft, and adjust the angle to reach each target. Watch where the last shot went so you can correct your aim before the next group gets too close.

pages.title: PingBol
pages.creator: Andrew Hadlington
pages.description: Launch balls in PingBol and bounce them into balls already on the board. Five hits clear a target for a point, but every ball expands when it stops moving. Watch where your shots can rebound, because a ball that reaches the red line costs you a life.

pages.title: Pump Up the Bubble
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Inflate your bubbles to take over enemy bubbles in Pump Up the Bubble. Click one of yours to make it grow, but leave enough space around it while it expands. If it touches something during growth it loses its size, so watch for a clear opening first.

pages.title: Magic Piano Tiles
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Tap black piano tiles in time to keep the song going in Magic Piano Tiles. Watch the stream of tiles and move to the next black one as soon as it comes into reach. Keep up with the music as you work through the sequence.

pages.title: Frog
pages.creator: Julio Cesar Fuente Saugar
pages.description: Hop toward the far bank in Frog, a version of Frogger. Start below the crossing and watch the route before each move. Time your hops to make it past the hazards and reach one of the five coves along the top edge.

pages.title: Mathai's Tea Shop
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Help Mathai look after customers in Mathai's Tea Shop. Keep up with the orders as people arrive and serve them what they ask for. Work toward the shop’s daily target as you handle the customers coming in throughout the day.

pages.title: Hero Jump Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Jump from platform to platform in Hero Jump Game. Pick up coins and use springs to send the hero higher, then watch for the super jump power-up for extra points. Keep the jumps going as far as you can across the sky.

pages.title: Christmas Gifts match 3
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Match holiday gifts in Christmas Gifts match 3. Look for groups of three matching pieces and clear them to make room for the next combination. Check the new arrangement after each match and see what you can bring together as the board changes.

pages.title: Santa's Mission
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Make matches on a holiday board in Santa's Mission. Check the targets for the level, then look for combinations that help you collect what’s required. Finish the mission to unlock the next puzzle and try for a better star rating on the boards you replay.

pages.title: Barbie Butterfly Diva
pages.creator: Bitent Media
pages.description: Get Barbie ready for a butterfly-themed competition in Barbie Butterfly Diva. Browse the dresses and try hairstyles and accessories that fit the theme. Put the pieces together to create an outfit she can wear when she takes part in the competition.

pages.title: College Love Chemistry Class
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Find the items you need before chemistry class in College Love Chemistry Class. Search for the missing supplies, then choose clothes and accessories suitable for the lab. Finish getting ready so you can meet your lab partner and start the experiment.

pages.title: Girls Fashion Performance
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress Strawberry Shortcake and her friends for their big show in Girls Fashion Performance. Look through the outfits and choose what each girl should wear to the contest. Try different combinations so the friends can each have their own look onstage.

pages.title: Couples New Year Party
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Get the couples ready for a New Year celebration in Couples New Year Party. Try dresses, hairstyles, and accessories for the girls, then choose outfits for the boys. Put together a look for each couple before sending them to the party.
